sources.snippet: tr-TR Detect AI in Turkish text. AI Checker is calibrated for Turkish with separate model weights for Turkish -specific patterns. Sentence-level breakdown, free. sources.snippet: We present community-driven BERT, DistilBERT, ELECTRA, ConvBERT and T5 models for Turkish 🎉 Some datasets used for pretraining and evaluation are contributed from the awesome Turkish NLP community, as well as the decision for the BERT model name: BERTurk.
